paragraphs: In the morning, follow up with clients and understand their goals and risk tolerance. At midday, review plans with the team and adjust allocations. In the afternoon, explain portfolios and sign plans. Track markets and rebalance, then organize the pipeline and client relationships before leaving and prepare to meet targets.

In one sentence: turn income into a plan that lets clients sleep soundly. Duties include financial diagnostics, allocation, product selection, rebalancing, and trust building. The role combines analysis and communication on the front line of wealth management.
